topics.title: Thanksgiving weather disruptions
topics.summary: Heavy rain, strong winds and flooding affected parts of the United States during the Thanksgiving travel period, prompting travellers to keep an eye on local conditions.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is your ideal plan B when weather scrambles a holiday or weekend trip: reschedule, turn it into a cozy stay-in day, or chase a completely different adventure?

topics.title: Miami runway disruption
topics.summary: A FedEx airplane overran a runway at Miami International Airport, temporarily limiting airport operations while passengers were advised to check airline updates.
topics.discussionPrompt: When travel plans suddenly change, are you a meticulous rebooker, a lounge-and-snack optimist, or someone who immediately looks for a road-trip alternative?

topics.title: Black Friday baskets evolve
topics.summary: Shoppers are mixing discounted household necessities with holiday gifts, while retailers use larger November promotions and AI tools to shape buying decisions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you had one budget for practical supplies and one fun splurge, which shopping list would be harder for you to keep under control?

topics.title: Global markets steady
topics.summary: Stocks rose in parts of Europe and Asia as technology shares rebounded, while United States markets remained closed for the Thanksgiving holiday.
topics.discussionPrompt: Do market headlines feel more like useful weather reports or mysterious background noise? What would make business news easier to follow?

topics.title: Pacific trade talks in Vietnam
topics.summary: Trade representatives from CPTPP, ASEAN and the European Union met in Vietnam, with proposed United States tariffs adding urgency to their economic discussions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a bunch of countries met to make everyday life smoother, which shared goal should top the list: cheaper groceries, easier travel, cleaner energy, or better internet?

topics.title: Faulty appliances and e-waste
topics.summary: A Guardian investigation reported that faulty electrical goods returned to UK supermarkets have ended up at an e-waste site in Ghana.
topics.discussionPrompt: What should happen to a gadget that fails right away: repair it locally, return it to the maker, or redesign products so their parts have a second life?

topics.title: Heathrow expansion questioned
topics.summary: A UK parliamentary transport committee said the case for a third Heathrow runway had not been adequately demonstrated against economic and climate commitments.
topics.discussionPrompt: For a busy city, would you rather invest in a bigger airport, faster trains, or better local transit? Which change would you notice most?

topics.title: More precise flood forecasting
topics.summary: Researchers are exploring how variations in tidal height across beaches could improve local flood forecasts and help communities prepare for changing coastal conditions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your phone could give a highly local flood forecast, what would you want it to include besides a warning: routes, timing, photos, or a checklist?

topics.title: Sydney fire ant discovery
topics.summary: Authorities reported finding a fire-ant nest with multiple queens in Sydney, highlighting the challenge of containing invasive species once they establish new colonies.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which tiny creature deserves more respect for its teamwork: ants, bees, termites, or something unexpected? What makes its group strategy impressive?

topics.title: New tariffs shape global trade
topics.summary: The United States announced new tariffs targeting a range of trading partners, while governments and businesses assessed potential effects on prices and supply chains.
topics.discussionPrompt: When trade rules shift, what everyday item do you think people notice first: food, electronics, clothing, or cars? Why that one?
